title: Consolidar verificaciones browser V18 duplicadas en una ruta canónica
mission: Reconcile the three overlapping Facultad V18 browser-only Notas/login verification jobs into one canonical surviving browser-capable route. Persist durable dispositions/supersession so generic workers stop seeing redundant variants while preserving the strongest combined acceptance criteria and the representative_javascript_browser requirement. Do not manufacture a browser verdict.
definition_of_done: Compare the exact durable definitions of portfolio-facultad-v18-notes-login-browser-verify-v1, portfolio-facultad-v18-notes-login-browser-capability-retry-v1 and portfolio-facultad-v18-notes-login-browser-capable-rerun-v1.
Persist an explicit durable disposition identifying one canonical browser-capable route and marking semantically redundant variants superseded/consumed without deleting historical evidence.

The canonical route preserves desktop+narrow/mobile JavaScript runtime verification, honest Notas/date states, capability-honest disabled generic login, Version anterior, runtime-error evidence and non-promotion boundaries.
Compiler/allocator-visible state no longer needs to expose multiple equivalent V18 Notas/login browser candidates to generic workers.
No Current, Human Accepted or Served promotion and no inferred browser PASS.
